decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Separate access to the residential accommodation on the upper floors of the premises shall be available to residents at all times.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority for a scheme of acoustic insulation of the ground floor restaurant and function area.

Condition : 5 - The kitchen extract system shall be provided before the use is brought into operation, and when at maximum operation shall not result in noise that is more than 10dB(A) below background noise levels for the site. The kitchen extract system shall include the following details:a) A three-stage filtration system, including grease filters, pre-carbon filters and carbon filters, to be located inside the building.b) The point of discharge shall be a minimum of one metre above eaves level or one metre above openable windows of nearby properties.c) The ducting shall be circular.d) The ventilation duct shall terminate pointing directly upwards and shall not be fitted with a cowl.e) The extract system should not cause an increase in background noise level in the vicinity, and when operating at maximum, should not be 10dB(A) lower than the BNL.e) The fan shall be isolated from the inlet and discharge ducts using flexible couplings.f) The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts.g) The duct shall be isolated from the structure of the building using anti-vibration mouldings and suitable packing material where it passes through solid structures.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times:Monday - Friday 11.00 to 23:30Saturday - 11.00 - 24.00Sunday - 11.00 to 23.30

Condition : 7 - The development shall not be occupied until a secure storage area within the site enclosed by a two metre high close boarded fence to house a minimum of two 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobins has been identified and made available, together with facilities for the separation and storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the bins in the designated area.  The lids of the Eurobins shall be kept shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.

Condition : 8 - Before the development commences, details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority of a scheme to prevent noise breakout from the building, including a noise limiter for any amplification system that is fitted and sound insulation measures for the structure including details of how the premises can be adequately ventilated with all doors and windows shut and measures to ensure that they are kept shut during functions.  These details as approved shall be implemented before the development is first occupied and permanently retained thereafter.
Condition : 9 - The servicing arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any of the uses hereby approved are occupied.

Condition : 10 - The amenity space for residents of the upper floors of the premises shown on the approved plans shall be laid out before the development is first brought into use and made permanently available for residents thereafter and shall be used for no other purpose.
Condition : 11 - The residential accommodation on the first, second and third floors shall be occupied by no more than 11 personsDevelopment) and H.4.1 (Housing Standards)
description: Change of use of 266 Bath Road from A2 (financial and professional services) to A3 (restaurant) on ground floor incorporating a rear extension to provide a function room and change of use of upper floors of 266 and 268 to a house in multiple occupancy incorporating rear first floor, rear second floor and rear roof extensions and installation of an extractor flue to the side elevation.
